{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A fitted blouse in crisp white with a subtle sheen, tailored silhouette that hits at the hip, pure white (#FFFFFF), woven cotton blend.
Tailored trousers in charcoal gray with a slight taper for ease of movement, cropped just above the ankle, dark charcoal (#36454F), heavy twill wool.
An unstructured blazer in black with notched lapels and single-button closure, relaxed fit through the sleeve to allow arm freedom, matte black (#000000), textured bouclé knit.
Leather ankle boots in deep espresso brown with a low block heel for stability on crowded floors, rounded toe, rich espresso brown (#3B2F2F), full-grain leather.
This outfit works because the classic register is maintained through tailored silhouettes and refined fabrics while the dark neutral palette keeps the look grounded against the chaotic energy of a rock venue. The unstructured bouclé blazer provides necessary warmth for autumn evenings without restricting movement, allowing you to stand comfortably in a crowd. The ankle boots offer essential stability on crowded dance floors where high heels would be impractical, balancing style with practicality."}
